title: Drive To The Backhand Side (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 138bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
Ball is sitting up, mid court, time to drive
Backhand side is open, go

[Verse 1]
Ball rises to mid height off the bounce
Paddle back to hip, load the ounce
Step into the ball, weight transfers through
Drive to the backhand side, that is the cue

Contact out front, paddle face flat
Follow through forward, level after that
Aim at the backhand hip, low and hard
Drive to the backhand, take the yard

[Pre-Chorus]
Load and step and drive through flat
Contact out front, follow after that
Backhand hip is the target zone
Drive to the backhand, own the throne

[Chorus]
Drive to the backhand side, low and true
Paddle face flat, weight drives through
Contact out front, follow long
Drive to the backhand, all day strong

[Verse 2]
Why the backhand side in a rally deep
Backhand return is harder to keep
Shorter swing, less power off the backhand
Drive there first, that is the game plan

[Bridge]
Bluey: She has driven it hard to the backhand side, wonderful placement
Trevor: Targeting the backhand hip reduces the opponents swing radius by thirty percent
Michelle: Backhand first. Then read what they give you back.

[Chorus]
Drive to the backhand side, low and true
Paddle face flat, weight drives through
Contact out front, follow long
Drive to the backhand, all day strong

[Outro]
Backhand hip
Low and flat
Drive to the backhand side
